trips.title: 3-Day Personalized Jaipur Explorer
trips.summary: A carefully curated 3-day journey across Jaipur balancing landmark historical sights, culinary trails, relaxed evenings, and rich cultural experiences tailored to your travel style.
travel_tips: Carry light cotton clothing, comfortable walking sneakers, and sunscreen for daytime exploration.
Digital payments (UPI/cards) are widely accepted across Jaipur, but keep small cash bills for autos and street food.
Book popular museum and monument entry tickets online in advance to bypass ticket queues.
Stay hydrated with fresh coconut water and local teas during outdoor sightseeing walks.

trips.title: 5-Day Goa Tropical Escape & Heritage Trail
trips.summary: An immersive 5-day escape through Goa combining sun-drenched northern beaches, Portuguese heritage alleys of Fontainhas, majestic forts, river cruises, and coastal dining.
travel_tips: Rent a scooter or car from the airport for convenient local navigation across North & South Goa.
Carry cash or UPI for local beach shacks and night markets as card connectivity can occasionally dip.
Dress respectfully with covered shoulders when visiting the Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral.
Best sunset cocktails and live acoustic music are between 5:30 PM and 7:00 PM along Vagator and Anjuna.

activities.name: Airport Arrival & Rental Pick-up
activities.description: Land at Goa Airport (GOI/GOX), pick up rental vehicle, and drive through scenic coconut groves.
activities.notes: Keep booking confirmation ready on phone.

activities.name: Seafood Lunch at Calamari Bathe & Binge
activities.description: Savor butter garlic calamari and kingfish curry with chilled coconut water right on Candolim Beach.

activities.name: Fort Aguada & Sea Lighthouse Tour
activities.description: Walk the ramparts of the 17th-century Portuguese fortress and take stunning photos of the Arabian Sea.

activities.name: Sunset Cocktails at Thalassa Greek Taverna
activities.description: Famous cliffside sunset views over Siolim river with Aegean music and delicious mezze platters.

activities.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus & Se Cathedral Walk
activities.description: Marvel at UNESCO World Heritage church with golden altars and the sacred relic of St. Francis Xavier.

activities.name: Traditional Goan Thali at Viva Panjim
activities.description: Tucked away in Fontainhas alleyways, serving iconic fish thalis, prawn vindaloo, and bebinca dessert.

activities.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Photo Walk
activities.description: Stroll past indigo, mustard yellow, and rose-pink colonial villas, charming art galleries, and bakeries.

activities.name: Mandovi River Sunset Cruise
activities.description: One-hour river cruise with live Goan folk dance performances (Dekhni & Fugdi) and golden sunset views.

activities.name: Sahakari Spice Farm Guided Tour & Buffet
activities.description: Guided walk through vanilla, cardamom, and betel nut trees followed by an authentic spice buffet lunch.

activities.name: Water Sports at Calangute & Baga
activities.description: Thrilling parasailing and jet-skiing over turquoise waves with trained instructors and safety gear.

activities.name: Live Music Dinner at Cafe Mojo Pub
activities.description: Self-serve beer taps, pool tables, live rock covers, and delicious wood-fired pizzas.

activities.name: Scenic Drive to South Goa & Cabo de Rama Fort
activities.description: Drive along coastal cliff roads to the ancient secluded cliff fort overlooking virgin blue waters.

activities.name: Riverside Feast at The Fisherman’s Wharf
activities.description: Enjoy signature butter garlic crabs, fish curry rice, and mocktails by the Sal river.

activities.name: Palolem Beach Kayaking & Sunset
activities.description: Gentle crescent bay with calm waters, ideal for kayaking to Butterfly Beach and watching the sun set.

activities.name: Organic Breakfast at Artjuna Garden Cafe
activities.description: Enjoy smoothie bowls, shakshuka, fresh croissants, and cold pressed juices in a bohemian garden.

activities.name: Souvenir & Cashew Shopping in Mapusa
activities.description: Pick up authentic Feni, roasted Goan cashews, homemade spice pastes, and ceramic azulejo tiles.

activities.name: Airport Transfer & Departure
activities.description: Return rental car at airport terminal and check in for flight with fond memories of Goa.

places.name: Fort Aguada & Lighthouse
places.description: A well-preserved seventeenth-century Portuguese fort standing on Sinquerim Beach overlooking the Arabian Sea, featuring a grand 4-story lighthouse.
places.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon for ocean breeze and sunset view

places.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
places.description: Baroque architecture jewel in Old Goa holding the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier. One of the oldest and most revered churches in India.
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours to avoid crowds

places.name: Fisherman's Wharf
places.description: Iconic riverside dining experience serving authentic Goan fish curry, butter garlic crab, prawn balchao, and refreshing cocktails by the Sal river.
places.best_time_to_visit: Dinner with live music

places.name: Taj Exotica Resort & Spa
places.description: Mediterranean-inspired luxury sanctuary spread across 56 acres along Benaulim Beach with private plunge pools, world-class spa, and golf course.
places.best_time_to_visit: Year round

places.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Walking Tour
places.description: Quaint, brightly-colored Portuguese villas, terracotta-tiled roofs, old bakeries, art galleries, and cozy cafes in Panaji.
places.best_time_to_visit: 08:00 AM - 10:30 AM or 04:00 PM - 06:00 PM for photography

places.name: Anjuna Flea Market & Curlies Sunset
places.description: Legendary bohemian beachfront market with handmade jewelry, tapestries, spices, live music, and unforgettable sunsets over the Arabian Sea.
places.best_time_to_visit: Wednesday afternoon towards sunset

places.name: Victoria Memorial Hall & Gardens
places.description: Imposing white Makrana marble monument dedicated to Queen Victoria, surrounded by 64 acres of lush gardens, housing a rich royal gallery.
places.address: 1, Queens Way, Maidan, Kolkata, West Bengal 700071
places.best_time_to_visit: 03:30 PM for garden walks and evening illumination

places.name: Flurys Heritage Tea Room & Bakery
places.description: Established in 1927 on Park Street, famed for legendary English breakfasts, rum balls, chicken patties, and Darjeeling first flush tea.
places.address: 18, Park St, Park Street area, Kolkata, West Bengal 700071
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning breakfast or late afternoon high tea

places.name: Kumartuli Potter’s Colony
places.description: Traditional clay idol-making quarter where generations of master artisans sculpt magnificent clay idols of deities from Ganges clay and straw.
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning 08:00 AM - 11:00 AM

places.name: The Oberoi Grand Kolkata
places.description: Known affectionately as the Grande Dame of Chowringhee, combining classic Victorian architecture, serene courtyard pool, and grand hospitality.
places.address: 15, Jawaharlal Nehru Rd, New Market Area, Kolkata 700013
places.best_time_to_visit: Year round

places.name: Tiger Hill Sunrise Point
places.description: Famous viewpoint offering an unforgettable sunrise view where morning rays illuminate the snow-clad peaks of Kanchenjunga and Mount Everest in gold and pink.
places.best_time_to_visit: 04:30 AM before dawn

places.name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
places.description: Second oldest tea estate in Darjeeling, established in 1854. Walk through manicured hills, watch plucking, and savor tea tasting sessions.
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning for fresh tea processing aroma

places.name: Keventer’s Open Terrace & Bakery
places.description: Colonial open rooftop cafe famous for traditional English breakfast platters, pork sausages, sandwiches, hot chocolate, and clear Himalayan mountain views.
places.best_time_to_visit: 08:30 AM for breakfast on the sun terrace

places.name: Amber Palace & Fort
places.description: Majestic hilltop fort featuring red sandstone and marble, mirror palace (Sheesh Mahal), courtyards, and panoramic views of Maota Lake.
places.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or illuminated evening

places.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
places.description: Unique five-story exterior facade resembling a honeycomb of a beehive with 953 small windows (jharokhas) decorated with intricate latticework.
places.address: Hawa Mahal Rd, Badi Choupad, J.D.A. Market, Jaipur 302002
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning sunlight shining on the facade from Wind View Cafe across the road

places.name: 1135 AD Fine Dining at Amber Fort
places.description: Dine like royalty inside the historical fort walls surrounded by pure gold leaf enameling, Belgian crystal chandeliers, live sitar music, and traditional Rajput cuisine.
places.address: Level 2, Jaleb Chowk, Near Shila Mata Temple, Amer, Jaipur 302001
places.best_time_to_visit: Candlelight royal dinner

places.name: Alleppey Luxury Backwaters Houseboat Cruise
places.description: Glide through tranquil emerald backwaters, palm-fringed canals, and paddy fields on a traditional thatched Kettuvallam with fresh coconut water and Karimeen fish fry.
places.best_time_to_visit: Noon till golden hour sunset

places.name: Munnar Tea Plantations & Eravikulam National Park
places.description: Rolling carpet of misty green tea gardens, endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goats, cascading waterfalls, and cool crisp mountain air at 1,600m altitude.
places.best_time_to_visit: Early morning misty sunrise

places.name: Kashi Art Cafe & Heritage Courtyard
places.description: Charming art gallery cafe in Fort Kochi serving artisanal roast coffee, fresh chocolate cake, homemade breads, and tropical salads amid contemporary art exhibits.
places.address: Burgher St, Fort Nagar, Fort Kochi, Kochi 682001
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning coffee or afternoon tea

places.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat Evening Ganga Aarti
places.description: World-renowned choreographed evening devotional ritual with brass lamps, blowing conch shells, incense smoke, and floating diya candles along the sacred Ganges river.
places.address: Dashashwamedh Ghat Rd, Ghats of Varanasi 221001
places.best_time_to_visit: Arrive by 05:45 PM or view from wooden boat on the river

places.name: Blue Lassi Shop
places.description: Legendary tiny heritage lassi counter since 1925 serving 80+ varieties of thick clay-cup (kulhad) lassi topped with malai, fresh pomegranate, mango, and pistachios.
places.address: CK 12/1 Kunj Gali, Near Manikarnika Ghat, Varanasi 221001
places.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon refreshment between ghat walks

places.name: Qutub Minar & Mehrauli Archaeological Park
places.description: A 73-meter fluted red sandstone victory tower built in 1192 surrounded by intricate carved arches, iron pillar that never rusts, and ancient tombs.
places.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon for golden sunlight on red stone

places.name: Chandni Chowk Old Delhi Street Food Trail
places.description: Sensory culinary journey through narrow lanes tasting hot stuffed paranthas at Paranthe Wali Gali, crispy jalebis, Natraj dahi bhalla, and royal butter chicken.
places.best_time_to_visit: 01:00 PM - 04:00 PM or evening snack hours

places.name: Taj Mahal & Mughal Charbagh Gardens
places.description: The breathtaking white marble mausoleum built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan for Mumtaz Mahal. Features mesmerizing symmetry, floral pietra dura inlay, and reflection pools.
places.address: Dharmapuri, Forest Colony, Tajganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001
places.best_time_to_visit: Dawn sunrise for golden glow or sunset across Yamuna river

places.name: Agra Fort & Diwan-i-Khas
places.description: Massive 16th-century fortress of red sandstone encompassing Jahangiri Mahal, Khas Mahal, Sheesh Mahal mirror palace, and panoramic views of the Taj Mahal.
places.address: Agra Fort, Rakabganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282003
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours for intricate sandstone photography

places.name: Solang Valley & Rohtang Alpine Route
places.description: High-altitude Himalayan valley famed for year-round adventure sports including paragliding, zorbing, skiing, snowmobiling, and spectacular glacier viewpoints.
places.address: Solang Valley, Vashisht, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning for clear skies, crisp mountain air & active sports

places.name: Hadimba Devi Ancient Cedar Temple
places.description: Built in 1553 AD amidst dense deodar cedar forests (Dhungri Van Vihar), featuring four-tiered wooden pagoda architecture and intricate brass carvings.
places.address: Hadimba Temple Rd, Old Manali, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131
places.best_time_to_visit: Morning peaceful walk through giant Himalayan deodars

saved_places.notes: Must visit during sunset for photos!
Great spot for breakfast and pastel portraits.
Plan for trip to Kolkata next winter.
